instagram.caption:
The dead electronics shelf.
The Media Center in the Living Room. Keep the television, sound and consoles working, cool and cabled so a fault is findable.

What done looks like:
1. Every cable labelled at both ends
2. Running in one bundle to a single labelled power strip. Nothing plugged in that serves a device you no longer own
3. A clear hand's gap of air around the amplifier
4. Every game controller

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success media center.
